info.name: bookSphere – Live Demo (Complementary)
info.description:
Complementary Postman collection for the bookSphere Live Demo.

Covers every REST endpoint NOT already exercised by the storytelling collection, plus systematic error-scenario testing for all endpoint categories.

Sections:
  A – Setup (Admin login, dynamic IDs harvest)
  B – Browse / Catalogue (Open API)
  C – User Management (profile, bookshelf, follow)
  D – Reviews (registered – CRUD cycle)
  E – Likes (all four entity types, full cycle)
  F – Admin Panel (books, authors, genres, moderation)
  G – Error Scenarios (4xx validation, 401/403, 404, edge-cases)

Pre-requisite: the storytelling collection has already been run so that real data
(books, reviews, users) exist in the database.

Variable {{base_url}} = http://localhost:8080
Variables populated by tests: {{admin_token}}, {{user_token}}, {{book_id}}, {{author_id}}, {{review_id}}, {{admin_user_id}}, {{target_user_id}}

item.name: A – Setup & Login
item.description: Register a fresh demo user and login as admin.  Auto-harvest IDs for later requests.

item.name: A0 – Register Demo Target User (for follow tests)
A2 – Login as Demo User (JWT harvest)
A4 – Harvest: Pick first Book ID from search
A5 – Harvest: Pick first Author ID from search
B – Browse / Catalogue (Open API)
item.description: All public read endpoints: books, authors, users, reviews.  No auth required.

item.name: B2 – Search Books (no filter – browse all)
B3 – Search Books by title (partial match)
B6 – Search Authors (no filter – browse all)
B9 – Get Reviews by IDs (bulk fetch)
B10 – Analytics: Book Rankings filtered by year
B11 – Analytics: Book Rankings filtered by genre
B12 – Analytics: Book Rankings filtered by author ID
B13 – Analytics: Influencers filtered by genre
C – User Profile & Social
item.description: Profile management (username update, delete account), bookshelf CRUD, and follow/unfollow cycle.

item.name: C2 – Add Book to Bookshelf (status: to_read)
D – Reviews (Registered CRUD)
item.description: Full CREATE → READ → UPDATE → DELETE cycle for user-authored reviews.

item.name: E – Likes (all entity types)
item.description: Like and unlike books, authors, and genres; retrieve each liked-list.

item.name: F – Admin Panel
item.description: Full admin CRUD for books, authors, genres and moderation tools (ban, delete review, list users/reviews). All requests use {{admin_token}}.

item.name: G – Error Scenarios
item.description: Systematic verification of error handling: 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, and endpoint-specific edge cases.

item.name: G6 – [401] Access protected endpoint without token
G7 – [401] Access admin endpoint with USER token
G8 – [403] Banned user tries to login
G9 – [404] Get non-existent Book by ID
G10 – [404] Get non-existent Author by ID
G11 – [404] Get non-existent User by username
G12 – [400] Create Review: rating out of range (101)
G14 – [400] Add Book to Bookshelf: invalid status value
G15 – [400] Analytics: author AND genre simultaneously (mutually exclusive)
G16 – [400] Book ID path param: malformed ObjectId
G17 – [400] Admin Ban: non-existent user ID
G18 – [400] Like book: invalid ObjectId in body
G19 – [400] Admin Add Book: publication year in the future
G20 – [400] Reviews: get reviews with empty review param list
Z – Cleanup
item.description: Final teardown: delete the demo user's account (self-deletion).
